facts.detail: The BDUK Research Portal was last updated on 26 June 2026.
The portal collects research and analysis documents from BDUK evaluation and analysis teams.
The portal groups evaluations, in-house research, evaluation plans and commissioned research.
The team includes data analysts, modellers, social researchers, economists and designers.
The research assesses intervention efficacy, informs programme design and examines resulting impacts.

facts.detail: BDUK published the annual 2025/26 delivery bulletin on 11 June 2026.
BDUK estimated that interventions delivered gigabit-capable coverage to 192,570 premises during 2025/26.
Annual delivery increased by 42,280 premises, or 28%, from the previous financial year.
The cumulative estimated total delivered through BDUK subsidy reached 1,418,410 premises.
Rural premises accounted for 90% of annual delivery, equal to 173,190 premises.

facts.detail: The official-statistics announcement was published on 23 June 2026.
The announcement is issued by Building Digital UK and the Department for Science, Innovation and Technology.
The planned release covers delivery from April through June 2026.
The release will report UK premises receiving gigabit-capable coverage as a result of BDUK subsidy.
The release date is listed as provisional for August 2026.

facts.detail: BDUK published the September 2025 OMR dataset on 8 January 2026.
Supplier-name errors were corrected and replacement files were issued on 2 February 2026.
The release provides Open Market Review determinations at UPRN level.
The data records current gigabit connectivity, future commercial plans and BDUK intervention plans.
The publication does not comprehensively represent historic voucher, GigaHubs and Superfast delivery.

facts.detail: BDUK published the January 2026 OMR and intervention-plan release on 4 June 2026.
The publication applies to England and Wales and links separate releases for Scotland and Northern Ireland.
The page provides a UPRN-level user guide, a sample CSV and regional ZIP files.
The release contains BDUK's premises-level view of current connectivity, future commercial plans and intervention premises.
Separate downloadable files are provided for English regions and Wales.
